Name: Bear Craftables (CP and AT)
Author: holythesea
Description:
Bear family reporting for duty! Put cute little bear faces on your [s]furnaces (and kegs and kilns)[/s] craftables.

Now featuring:
[list]
[*]Bear Bee House
[*]Bear Kiln
[*]Bear Furnace
[*]Crystal-Bear-ium
[*]Bear Keg
[*]Bear Preserves Jar
[*]Mr. Bear-naise Maker
[*]Bear Loom
[*]Bear Lightning Rod
[*]Bear-cycling Bin
[*]Bear Chest
[*]Bearcrow
[/list]
[size=5]This mod was [i]heavily[/i] inspired by the [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/355165]Bear Furnace[/url]﻿ that I found on Naver[/size]
and a lot of jokes with folks in the SDV modding discord community about bears. The Naver mod author states open permissions, so I thought that I would upload my CP and AT conversions of Bear Furnace to Nexus for everyone to enjoy (: I also added my own retextures of other craftables to match.

[i]In-game screenshot of textures[/i]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BkhSzum.png[/img]

[b]Highly recommended mod to go with this[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12623]Bear Shipping Bin[/url] by Berryz on Nexus
